cases.title: Typed getters return declared values
cases.when: A handler reads each declared variable kind with its typed getter

cases.title: An undeclared name or wrong type is an error
cases.when: A handler reads an undeclared name and reads a declared name with the wrong type
then: Compile error where the language can detect it (generator literals, analyzers), otherwise ToolConfigurationError

cases.title: Only declared claims are readable
cases.when: A handler reads a declared claim and an undeclared claim present in the token

cases.title: invocation() carries the specified fields
then: invocationId, toolId, deadline, attempt and mode are set; agentId, userId, catalogRevision and businessKey when applicable

cases.title: progress() is bounded and monotonic
cases.when: A handler reports 0.5, 0.3, 1.2, then 0.9 in a task
then: 0.3 is ignored as non-monotonic, 1.2 is rejected
In a sync call without a progress token all are ignored

cases.title: isCancelled and the language token are set together
cases.when: tasks/cancel arrives while the handler polls isCancelled and waits on the language token

cases.title: requestInput suspends for input
cases.when: A handler calls requestInput in a task and in a sync MRTR call
then: Task: input_required then resumed by tasks/update

cases.title: log() redacts and caps
cases.when: A handler logs a secret value and 300 KiB of text
then: 4 KiB per entry and 256 KiB per invocation

cases.title: secret() on a brokered-only secret fails in governed mode
cases.when: A governed handler calls secret() for a brokered-only secret

cases.title: Generated accessors match declarations
cases.when: The generator runs for a tool with a global timeoutSeconds
then: A typed accessor (OrderToolsVars.global(context).timeoutSeconds() or its language equivalent) exists
Python and TypeScript expose typed access through their declared types
